verdict.rationale: TaxJar documents a public REST API covering sales tax rates, calculations, transactions, nexus regions and address/VAT validation. The docs specify API-key authentication, header-based versioning and a sandbox endpoint, and official clients exist for seven languages, with the Node client listing the endpoints it maps to. Missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI/Swagger spec (all probed paths returned 404), independent hands-on corroboration of driving the API, and evidence that filing/AutoFile functions can be driven via the API.
